text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, that's pretty much the gist of it~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, a grand victory for Sei-chan's 
brilliant tactics!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The plan worked like a charm, and everyone 
was surprised! That was so exhilarating~!
choice_data_list:
We need to work out our next strategy, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The next race should be an easy win with 
Sei-chan's strategy too, I guess~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that being the case, is it cool if 
I go back to non-stop fishing and 
sunbathing all day starting tomorrow?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's not like I want to slack off or 
anything. It's a strategy to catch 
everyone off guard, fufu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky laughed in a tone that made it 
impossible to tell whether she was joking 
or serious.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
True, true~. I wonder what kind of 
strategy I should go with next.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I can't wait... Just imagining the 
look of surprise on everyone's faces.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow everyone away with Sei-chan's 
brilliant strategies again♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky already seemed to be scheming a 
plan toward her next victory.
